code: # _targets.R library(geotargets) library(tarchetypes) library(targets) library(terra) library(urbioconnect)  ## Load any R files tar_source()  ## Assign like regular R, just make sure to pipe into a tar_ operation tar_assign({   species <- tar_target("Blue-Tongued-Lizard")   data_resolution <- tar_target(10)   interpatch_distance <- tar_target(10)      barrier <- example_barrier() |> tar_terra_rast()   habitat <- example_habitat() |> tar_terra_rast()    barrier_mask <- create_barrier_mask(barrier) |> tar_terra_rast()   remaining <- drop_habitat_under_barrier(habitat, barrier_mask) |>     tar_terra_rast()   buffered_habitat <- habitat_buffer(remaining, interpatch_distance = interpatch_distance) |>     tar_terra_rast()   fragmentation_raster <- fragment_habitat(buffered_habitat, barrier_mask) |>     tar_terra_rast()    # get IDs of connected areas   # intersect with habitat to get area IDs of habitat patches   patches <- assign_patches_to_fragments(remaining, fragmentation_raster) |>     add_patch_area() |>     tar_terra_rast()   areas <- aggregate_connected_patches(patches) |>     tar_target()    # or as one step   areas_connected <- habitat_connectivity(     habitat = habitat,     barrier = barrier,     species = "Blue-tongued Lizard",     interpatch_distance = interpatch_distance   ) |>     tar_target()    results_connect_habitat <- summarise_connectivity(     connectivity = areas_connected   ) |>     tar_target() })

title: Getting started
text: habitat_buffer() expands habitat outward using circular focal window. spatial operation buffering, use represent interpatch distance - buffer_radius half species’ connectivity threshold. example, two patches considered connected within 200 m , use 100 m buffer, buffers overlap patches within 200 m. blue-tongued lizard urban Melbourne, median dispersal distance 1000 m (Kirk et al., 2023), use buffer 500 m. However, use 10 faster demonstration small example dataset, define interpatch_distance buffer_radius time.  can now visualise three layers together using gg_barrier_habitat_interpatch_dist():
code: interpatch_distance <- 10 buffer_radius <- interpatch_distance / 2  buffered_habitat <- habitat_buffer(   habitat = remaining_habitat,   buffer_radius = buffer_radius ) #> Warning: `interpatch_distance` doesn't align with the raster resolution. #> ✖ 10 m isn't a multiple of 4 m. #> ℹ It snaps to 8 m. #> ℹ Connectivity may shift for patches near the cut-off. #> ℹ See `vignette(urbioconnect::interpatch-distance-and-resolution)`.  plot(barrier_mask, col = scales::alpha("grey", 1), legend = FALSE) plot(buffered_habitat, col = "darkgreen", legend = FALSE, add = TRUE) plot(remaining_habitat, col = "#1b9e77", legend = FALSE, add = TRUE) gg_barrier_habitat_interpatch_dist(   barrier = barrier,   buffered = buffered_habitat,   habitat = remaining_habitat,   interpatch_distance = interpatch_distance,   species = "Blue-tongued Lizard",   col_barrier = "grey30",   col_interpatch_dist = "lightgreen",   col_habitat = "#1b9e77",   col_paper = "white" ) #> <SpatRaster> resampled to 500554 cells. #> <SpatRaster> resampled to 500554 cells. #> <SpatRaster> resampled to 500554 cells.

title: Getting started
text: summarise_connectivity() takes patch area data computes set landscape-level connectivity metrics: two key metrics : Effective mesh size (ha) - average area patch randomly chosen animal finds . Larger values mean better connectivity: meff=∑Ai2∑Ai×0.0001m_{\text{eff}} = \frac{\sum A_i^2}{\sum A_i} \times 0.0001 Probability connectedness - probability two randomly chosen points within habitat connected patch. Ranges 0 (fully fragmented) 1 (habitat connected). scenario measured baseline’s total habitat area, one adds habitat can score 1. terms hectares: Pc=mefftotal habitat areaP_c = \frac{m_{\text{eff}}}{\text{total habitat area}} AiA_i area given patch.
code: results <- summarise_connectivity(   connectivity = areas_connected$area,   interpatch_distance = interpatch_distance,   data_resolution = terra::res(habitat)[1],   species = "Blue-tongued Lizard" )  results #> # A tibble: 1 × 9 #>   species     interpatch_distance n_patches effective_mesh_ha prob_connectedness #>   <chr>                     <dbl>     <int>             <dbl>              <dbl> #> 1 Blue-tongu…                  10       703              3.92              0.149 #> # ℹ 4 more variables: patch_area_mean <dbl>, patch_area_total_ha <dbl>, #> #   data_resolution <dbl>, patch_size <list>
